title: NEW MSFS 2024 Marketplace activities! (watch before you nuy)
description:
Looking to add purpose, structured airline schedules, and high-stakes touchdown practice to your flight log in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? The Marketplace just expanded with three brand-new activity packages from Perfect Flight—offering three completely different styles of flying. Whether you want to step into the flight deck for scheduled airBaltic turns in the Airbus A220, operate European VIP charter contracts in the iniBuilds A320neo V2, or test your stick-and-rudder precision across 24 steep Alpine runways, this week's drop delivers hours of focused flying!

In this activity breakdown, we organize the latest marketplace arrivals into clear categories to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your flight log:

✈️ COMMERCIAL & CHARTER AIRLINE ROTATIONS
We kick off with Perfect Flight’s A220 BTI Fall 2026 package featuring 12 scheduled European legs with authentic airBaltic livery, in-game briefings, and over 100 tracked events. We also review a critical buyer warning: this add-on requires you to already own the Synaptic A220 (with livery pack) or the Virtualcol A220 series! Next, we look at the PLAY Europe Charter expansion: 8 unique holiday and VIP transport missions flown with the default iniBuilds Airbus A320neo V2, carrying sports fans, symphony orchestras, and film crews across the continent.

🎯 MOUNTAIN ARRIVAL & BUSH STRIP CHALLENGES
Ready to sharpen your flare and rollout technique? Perfect Flight presents Advanced Challenges: Alps Landings, featuring 24 handcrafted scenarios across France, Switzerland, Italy, and Austria. From hair-raising stepped altiports with up to 18.6% inclines (including Notre-Dame-de-la-Salette) and 7,000+ ft perched alpine strips to complex airliner valley arrivals into Innsbruck and Sion, we examine the fleet requirements—spanning the Boeing 737 MAX 8, A320, Daher TBM 930, and GA bush planes.

Which of these new activities are you loading up first? Flying scheduled airline shifts with airBaltic and PLAY, or testing your manual landing skills in the Alps? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you find your next flight adventure in MSFS 2024, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
